digest.component_or_area: transition request value object and close-reason/force gate
propositions: Close-reason and force plumbing logic is duplicated across CLI transition.py, library _lib_writes.py, and MCP _mcp_writes.py with inconsistent behavior: CLI refuses inadmissible reasons while library silently discards them.
The '(no reason given)' placeholder literal is produced in five code sites across three files without a single canonical source, violating guard requirements.

MCP transition_ticket does not expose reason parameter at all, causing a strict-xfail in write_parity_contract.py and leaving reason-required transitions unable to persist closure justification on that surface.

A bare --force close depends on placeholder normalization occurring before the refusal check at txn.py:232; moving this normalization relative to refusal logic or making force_note lazy risks flipping acceptance to rejection.
An empty reason normalizing to the placeholder before close_disposition.verdict could turn an UNJUSTIFIED disposition into a SIGNED one, violating the closed disposition contract.
